title: Location
description: Location bible (production/locations/<LOC_ID>/location.yaml): canonical description, time-of-day states, and reference assets. Geometry lives in the sibling map.yaml.

id.description: Location ID, e.g. LOC_FERRY_DECK. Matches the directory name.

description.description: Canonical description. Prompts are compiled from these fields.

summary.description: The location in one or two sentences.

dressing.description: Movable dressing that recurs across panels.

light.description: Light sources and how they behave.

prompt_summary.description: One generation-ready sentence used verbatim in prompts.

time_of_day_states.description: Times of day the location is shown in.

map_file.description: Path of this location's map.yaml, relative to the location directory.

status.description: Approval status of the bible entry.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
